QuickMind questions,

Compare plans, understand the product and check what to confirm before ordering.

Compare Home & Clinic Plans
1. What is QuickMind Home?

QuickMind Home is a proposed VR cognitive training offer for home users and caregivers. It combines rented equipment with an annual training subscription. Exact hardware, activities and support are defined in your written quotation.

Read the full answer →
2. Who is the home system suitable for?

Suitability depends on the exact product model, intended use and user needs. Age limits, precautions and any professional supervision must be confirmed before an offer is accepted.

Read the full answer →
3. How does the Home Plan differ from a clinic configuration?

The proposed Home Plan is for one named trainee and home cognitive training. Clinic configurations can include assessment and/or training modules, with hardware and user capacity specified separately.

Read the full answer →
4. What training activities are available?

The current materials describe cognitive domains including attention, memory, calculation, abstraction and executive function. The specific activity library depends on the quoted product and software configuration.

Read the full answer →
5. Can users and caregivers see progress reports?

Available reporting may show training completion and supported performance measures. Caregiver access and the exact report format must be confirmed for your configuration.

Read the full answer →
6. What equipment and accessories are included?

The proposed offer includes one rented QuickMind headset. Exact model, controllers, charger, companion device and accessories will be itemized in your written offer.

Read the full answer →
7. What do I need to set up the system?

Internet access, safe space, companion-device requirements and supported account configuration depend on the hardware and software supplied. These requirements should be confirmed before ordering.

Read the full answer →
8. Which languages does QuickMind support?

Language availability is confirmed for the exact product version. An English website and a country selector do not guarantee that the training software is available in every local language.

Read the full answer →
9. How long and how often should I train?

This website does not set a universal training prescription. Session duration and frequency should follow the instructions for the supplied product and any agreed professional guidance.

Read the full answer →
10. What research supports the product?

The evidence page summarizes four supplied papers on VR cognitive assessment and related screening methods, with study populations and limitations. These are not proof of the treatment efficacy of the proposed Home Plan.

Read the full answer →
11. Is QuickMind approved or registered in my country?

Registration, listing, notification and conformity records refer to named products and jurisdictions. Their presence does not establish worldwide delivery eligibility or apply automatically to every commercial configuration.

Read the full answer →
12. Where has the system been demonstrated or used overseas?

The site includes company-supplied photographs of demonstrations in Singapore and Indonesia and community sessions in Hong Kong. These document the settings shown, rather than clinical outcomes.

Read the full answer →
13. How much does the first year cost?

The proposed US offer is $499 for the initial equipment rental plus $1,999 for one year of subscription: $2,498 before taxes and shipping. This remains a proposed price pending a confirmed quotation.

Read the full answer →
14. Do I own the headset after paying the rental charge?

No. Under the proposed rental model, the equipment remains the supplier’s property. The $499 charge is not represented as a refundable deposit.

Read the full answer →
15. How does the annual subscription renew?

The proposed renewal is $1,999 per year without another initial equipment charge during uninterrupted rental. Billing dates, cancellation notice and renewal arrangements must be confirmed in writing.

Read the full answer →
16. How can I pay with PayPal or a bank card?

The payment area loads the supplied official PayPal Hosted Buttons component. PayPal determines which payment methods are available for the buyer and transaction.

Read the full answer →
17. Can you ship to my country?

The team accepts enquiries for the US, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and other destinations. Product eligibility, stock and shipping must be confirmed for your specific country.

Read the full answer →
18. What happens if I cancel or return the equipment?

The rental and refund policy is not finalized on this preview. No full refund, free return shipping or cancellation entitlement is promised beyond the terms ultimately agreed for your transaction.

Read the full answer →
19. What setup support and warranty are provided?

Setup instructions and remote onboarding are proposed. Warranty duration, service coverage, support language and response times depend on the confirmed offer.

Read the full answer →
20. Can clinics or distributors request a demonstration and commercial offer?

Yes. Use the same enquiry form and select Clinic / care organization or Distributor / commercial partner. Include your country, organization, device quantity and required workflow.
